decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposals because they involve a substantial alteration in the style, appearance and ridge of the roof, including the introduction of a flat roof, would be intrusive alterations, out of scale, proportion and character with the property, as well as having an adverse effect on the visual amenity and style of the bungalow dwelling and also be contrary to Policies ENV1.1 and  H.3.4 of this Council's UDP.

Condition : 2 - The proposed flank dormer, because of its size, design and appearance, would dominate the roof face in which it is set and be at odds with the style and character of the bungalow dwelling, as well as being out of character with the prevailing pattern of development in the area and contrary to Policies ENV1.1 and H3.4 of this Council's UDP

Condition : 3 - The proposal, because of the deficient number of and size of parking spaces provided, would lead to an unsatisfactory development of the site with inadequate car parking arrangements, likely to give rise to indiscriminate kerbside parking at and within the vicinity of the site, which in turn would be detrimental to the safety of both vehicles and pedestrians and would also be contrary to Policy T.2.5 of this Council's Unitary Development Plan.
description: Alterations to existing roof to raise the height incorporating loft conversion and roof extension to form additional bedroom and bathroom to dwellinghouse
